native_mechanisms: A single never-reset accumulator: every fold carries the accumulated callus of all previous folds (one serial chain over the whole pile).
Each new mark's weight is injected into the accumulator's already-transformed state, so earlier marks bend how later marks land (order-dependent, avalanching state dependence).
Only the accumulator's final state is emitted as the token; all intermediate states and residue are discarded.
core_technique: xxHash64: 8-lane (4-lane-style) striped multiply-rotate-add accumulators over 64-byte blocks, merge-round collapse, length injection, 8/4/1-byte tail folding, and an xor-shift/multiply final avalanche — i.e. the known multiply-xor-shift accumulator approach plus generic loop-unrolling/ILP striping, which actually breaks the native's single serial never-lifted chain into eight independent ones.
